proposal: fix('DNK', 'Frederikshavn', C, '丹麥能源署：港口擴建後 3 部試驗機中兩部已與陸地相連，海上只剩 1 部 2.3 MW；能源署風機登記檔（Vinddata，2026-10）與 OSM 都顯示仍在海上的是 Nordex N90/2300（GSRN 570715000000057489；Bonus 2.3 MW 與 Vestas V90 已改為陸上）；座標改到這部風機（2003 年時為 3 部、7.6 MW）', 'Danish Energy Agency: after the harbour extension two of the three test turbines are now land-connected and only one 2.3 MW turbine is left at sea; the agency’s turbine register (Vinddata, Oct 2026) and OpenStreetMap both show the one at sea is the Nordex N90/2300 (GSRN 570715000000057489; the Bonus 2.3 MW and the Vestas V90 are now listed on land); point moved to that turbine (3 turbines, 7.6 MW in 2003)', 'https://ens.dk/energikilder/etablerede-havvindmoelleparker', mw=2.3, turbine='1x Nordex N90/2300', lat=57.442, lon=10.565, note=True). FOUNDATION: keep in EXCLUDED but reword: the remaining turbine is the Nordex N90; Nordex (2003) only says it stands on 'a heavy-duty foundation tied to the seabed by means of planking and piles' (type not determinable; possibly a sheet-pile/cofferdam-like base) — lead.
note_zh: 能源署網站：2003 年 3 部（1 部 3 MW、2 部 2.3 MW，共 7.6 MW），「今天其中兩部已與陸地相連」，名單寫「Frederikshavn (2003) 1 部，2.3 MW」。兩部 2.3 MW 是 Bonus 與 Nordex N90。能源署 2026-10 的風機登記檔（Vinddata.xlsx，check_quotes 讀不了 xlsx，只作佐證）：Nordex N90/2300（GSRN …57489）「HAV」，Bonus（…57465）與 V90（…57472）「LAND」；OSM 只有 Nordex 那個節點標 offshore=yes（節點屬於「Nordhavnen Vindmøller」關係，位置 57.4420, 10.5654）。所以海上剩的是 Nordex N90。注意登記檔中這部 2026 年 1–8 月發電量為 0（可能停機）。基礎：Nordex 2003 年新聞稿只說是「以板樁與樁固定在海床的重型基礎」，判斷不了型式；兩部 Vestas 是吸力桶試驗（已在陸上），所以水下基礎仍列 EXCLUDED。
note_en: Danish Energy Agency page: 3 turbines in 2003 (one 3 MW, two 2.3 MW, 7.6 MW in all), ‘today two of the offshore turbines are land-connected’, and its list says ‘Frederikshavn (2003) 1 turbine, 2.3 MW’. The two 2.3 MW units were a Bonus and a Nordex N90. The agency’s Oct 2026 turbine register (Vinddata.xlsx; check_quotes cannot read xlsx, so supporting only) lists the Nordex N90/2300 (GSRN …57489) as ‘HAV’ (sea) and the Bonus (…57465) and V90 (…57472) as ‘LAND’; in OSM only the Nordex node carries offshore=yes (member of relation ‘Nordhavnen Vindmøller’, at 57.4420, 10.5654). So the turbine left at sea is the Nordex N90. Note the register shows zero output for it in Jan–Aug 2026 (possibly out of service). Foundation: Nordex’s 2003 release only says ‘a heavy-duty foundation tied to the seabed by means of planking and piles’, which does not fix a type; the two Vestas were the suction-bucket trial (now on land). So the foundation stays in EXCLUDED.
why: Foundation type of the remaining Nordex unit not determinable (only 'heavy-duty foundation ... planking and piles'). GEUS 2007 report is an AES-encrypted PDF (unreadable).

proposal: fix('FIN', 'Ajos Retrofit wind farm', G, 'OX2 2017 年 10 月將汰換後的 Ajos 風場交給 IKEA Finland：8 部 Siemens SWT-3.3-130（人工島與防波堤上）＋5 部 SWT-3.2-113（Ajos 島上），共 42.4 MW；新機組 2016–2017 年豎立，取代原本 10 部 WinWinD', 'OX2 handed the repowered Ajos farm to IKEA Finland in October 2017: 8 Siemens SWT-3.3-130 (on artificial islands and breakwaters) plus 5 SWT-3.2-113 (on Ajos island), 42.4 MW in all; the new turbines went up in 2016–2017, replacing the 10 original WinWinD units', 'https://news.cision.com/ox2/r/ox2-hands-over-ajos-wind-farm-to-ikea-finland,c2361999', mw=42.4, year=2017, ph=[[2017, 42.4]], turbine='8x Siemens SWT-3.3-130 + 5x Siemens SWT-3.2-113'); fix('FIN', 'Kemi wind farm', G, 'PVO-Innopower 的原 Ajos 風場：10 部 WinWinD WWD-3（3 MW），2007–2008 年分兩期建成，共 30 MW（GEM 寫 27 MW）；2016 年起由 OX2 汰換', 'PVO-Innopower’s original Ajos farm: 10 WinWinD WWD-3 (3 MW) built in two stages in 2007–2008, 30 MW in all (GEM says 27 MW); replaced by OX2 from 2016', 'https://fi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kemin_tuulipuisto', mw=30, turbine='10x WinWinD WWD-3', ph=[[2008, 30]])
note_zh: 沿革：原 Ajos 風場（PVO-Innopower）10 部 WinWinD WWD-3（3 MW）：第一期 2 部在 Ajos 島、3 部在人工島（15 MW），之後再 5 部在人工島，合計 30 MW，2008 年完成（芬蘭文維基）。2016 年 1 月 OX2 買下，2016–2017 年換成 13 部 Siemens：8 部 SWT-3.3-130 在人工島與防波堤、5 部 SWT-3.2-113 在陸上，合計 42.4 MW，2017-10-06 商轉交給 IKEA（OX2 新聞稿、施工廠商 AINS）。所以 43 MW 應為 42.4 MW；GEM 的 2016 年 10 MW＋2017 年 33 MW 分期查不到出處，建議改為 2017 年完工一筆。舊紀錄 GEM「Kemi wind farm」27 MW 應為 30 MW。另提醒：精選紀錄「Kemi Ajos」原為離岸型，dup 併入 GEM 後是陸域；8 部在人工島上（OX2 稱為 offshore），本站芬蘭的離岸統計也把 Kemi Ajos 算 24 MW 離岸（wind_global.json），型別要不要改由主程序決定。
note_en: History: the original Ajos farm (PVO-Innopower) had 10 WinWinD WWD-3 (3 MW): stage 1 with 2 turbines on Ajos island and 3 on artificial islands (15 MW), then 5 more on artificial islands, 30 MW in all, finished in 2008 (Finnish Wikipedia). OX2 bought it in January 2016 and replaced them in 2016–2017 with 13 Siemens turbines: 8 SWT-3.3-130 on artificial islands and breakwaters and 5 SWT-3.2-113 on land, 42.4 MW, commissioned and handed to IKEA on 6 Oct 2017 (OX2 release; contractor AINS). So 43 MW should be 42.4 MW; GEM’s 10 MW (2016) + 33 MW (2017) split has no source, so one 2017 completion is proposed. The old GEM record ‘Kemi wind farm’ (27 MW) should be 30 MW. Note: the curated ‘Kemi Ajos’ was typed offshore, but after the dup it lives in the onshore GEM record; 8 of the turbines stand on artificial islands (OX2 calls them offshore) and wind_global.json counts Kemi Ajos as 24 MW offshore — whether to type it offshore is the main session’s call.

proposal: fix('AUS', 'Gullen Range wind farm', G, '73 部 Goldwind（56 部 GW100-2.5MW＋17 部 GW82-1.5MW），165.5 MW，2014 年 12 月全部運轉', '73 Goldwind turbines (56 GW100-2.5MW + 17 GW82-1.5MW), 165.5 MW, fully operational in December 2014', 'https://gullenrangewindfarm.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/NGRWF-Annual-Environmental-Management-Report_2024-signed.pdf', mw=165.5, turbine='56x Goldwind GW100-2.5MW + 17x Goldwind GW82-1.5MW'). LEAD (not a write): GULLRWF2 (110 MW) is very probably Biala Wind Farm, which feeds through the Gullen Range substation; if the main session accepts the evidence, map GULLRWF2 to 'Biala wind farm' in build_live_units.py MANUAL instead of Gullen Range.
note_zh: Gullen Range 本身：業主 2024 年環境報告寫 73 部（56 部 GW100-2.5MW、17 部 GW82-1.5MW）、最大 165.5 MW，2014 年 12 月全面運轉；所以是 165.5 MW。GULLRWF2：AEMO 2020-21 邊際損失係數報告在 2020 年 7 月新增「Gullen Range 2 Wind Farm」(GULLRWF2, NGUR3G) 連接點，與 Gullen Range 1、Gullen Range 太陽光電同在 NGUR 節點；AEMO 名單裡沒有任何叫 Biala 的機組。Biala 風場（BJCE、約 110 MW、31 部，2020 年首度發電）以 12 km 地下電纜接到 Gullen Range 變電所，變電所 2020 年為它擴建。容量（110 MW）、時間（2020）、接點都對得上，幾乎可以確定 GULLRWF2＝Biala，但沒有文件直接寫出這個對應，依規則先列線索。本站另有 Biala 紀錄（111 MW），所以 Gullen Range 的實測發電量不應把 GULLRWF2 算進去。
note_en: Gullen Range itself: the owner’s 2024 environmental report gives 73 turbines (56 GW100-2.5MW, 17 GW82-1.5MW), up to 165.5 MW, fully operational in December 2014; so 165.5 MW. GULLRWF2: AEMO’s 2020-21 loss-factor report added a ‘Gullen Range 2 Wind Farm’ (GULLRWF2, NGUR3G) connection point in July 2020, at the same NGUR node as Gullen Range 1 and the Gullen Range solar farm, and AEMO lists no unit named Biala. Biala Wind Farm (BJCE, about 110 MW, 31 turbines, first power in 2020) connects by a 12 km underground cable to the Gullen Range substation, which was extended for it in 2020. Capacity (110 MW), timing (2020) and connection all match, so GULLRWF2 is almost certainly Biala, but no document states the mapping, so under the rules it stays a lead. The site has a separate Biala record (111 MW), so Gullen Range’s measured output should not include GULLRWF2.
